subject.title: refactor(pairing): store channel pairing state in SQLite

question: Is it acceptable for an upgrade to stop honoring ambiguous or unresolved legacy pairing files immediately, leaving them in place with a warning until the operator resolves them?
rationale: These files gate assistant access; assigning them to the wrong account could broaden access, while ignoring them can lock out previously approved senders, so the intended fail-closed upgrade behavior requires explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Keep fail-closed migration
options.body: Retain the proposed behavior, but require live upgrade proof and an actionable doctor or startup recovery message before merge.

options.title: Delay the runtime flip
options.body: Continue using the legacy store until doctor has resolved every recognizable source, then switch runtime to SQLite later.

options.title: Preserve a runtime fallback
options.body: Read unresolved JSON temporarily, accepting a second source of truth and a larger cross-account security surface.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Retain the proposed behavior, but require live upgrade proof and an actionable doctor or startup recovery message before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the database-first direction and Telegram pairing setup surface.
